info.title: Get Transactions by Statement
info.description:
Retrieves the details of a statement, including the transactions, which can be a standard order transaction, an adjustment transaction, or a reserve-related transaction. For the SKU-level details of an order transaction, refer to [Get Transactions by Order](650a6734defece02be67d724).
Applicable for all regions' sellers. Only data after 2023-07-01 is available (Please note that for US cross-border sellers, data before 2025-04-30 is unavailable).

get.description:
Retrieves the details of a statement, including the transactions, which can be a standard order transaction, an adjustment transaction, or a reserve-related transaction. For the SKU-level details of an order transaction, refer to [Get Transactions by Order](650a6734defece02be67d724).
Applicable for all regions' sellers. Only data after 2023-07-01 is available (Please note that for US cross-border sellers, data before 2025-04-30 is unavailable).

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. Retrieve this value from the result of the `next_page_token` from a previous response. It is not needed for the first page.

parameters.name: sort_field
parameters.description: The returned results will be sorted by the specified field. Only supports `order_create_time`.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description:
The sort order for the `sort_field` parameter. 
Default: ASC 
Possible values:
- ASC: Ascending order
- DESC: Descending order

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description:
The number of results to be returned per page. 
Default: 20
Valid range: [1-100]

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

next_page_token.description: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. Provide this value in the `page_token` parameter of your request if the current response does not return all the results.

create_time.description:
The time when the statement was generated. Unix timestamp. 
Statements are generated daily at 00:00 UTC.

currency.description: The three-digit currency code in ISO 4217 format.

payable_amount.description:
The final amount paid out after accounting for reserve funds.
Formula: total_settlement_amount + total_reserve_amount

total_reserve_amount.description:
The total amount withheld from settlement based on TikTok Shop Reserve Policy. Refer to TikTok Shop Academy for more information.
- A positive amount indicates the funds that have been released.
- A negative amount indicates the funds being withheld from the settlement.

Applicable only for UK and US local sellers.

total_settlement_amount.description:
The total settlement amount.

Formula: total_revenue_amount - total_shipping_cost_amount - total_fee_tax_amount - total_adjustment_amount

total_revenue_amount.description: The total revenue amount at the time of order settlement. This is equivalent to the net sales amount.

total_shipping_cost_amount.description: The total shipping costs at the time of order settlement.

total_fee_tax_amount.description: The total fees and taxes charged by the platform at the time of order settlement. Shipping-related costs are excluded.

total_adjustment_amount.description:
The total adjustment amount based on TikTok Shop policy. 
Refer to `transactions.type` for the list of adjustment-related policies.

total_settlement_breakdown.description: The list of amounts that directly contribute to `total_settlement_amount`.

total_count.description: The number of transaction records in the statement.

type.description:
The transaction type.

**Standard transactions**
- `ORDER`: A transaction related to an order settlement.
- `RESERVE`: A transaction involving collection or release of reserve funds.
- If the transaction is an adjustment, it returns one of the following values:

**Platform-related adjustments**
- `CHARGE_BACK`: Charges returned to a payment card after a customer has successfully disputed an item on their account statement or transactions report.
- `CUSTOMER_SERVICE_COMPENSATION`: Extra compensation or compensation paid to a customer after the after-sales period by customer service.
- `DEDUCTIONS_INCURRED_BY_SELLER`: Deduction arising from customer dissatisfaction as a result of the seller's responsibility. This includes issues such as fraud, empty packages, items that do not match the product display page, or items of lower value than advertised.
- `GMV_PAYMENT_FOR_ADS`: Amount used to pay for your advertisement if you are enabled "auto pay ads with shop GMV", or to pay for Tiktok Promote ads orders.
- `PLATFORM_COMMISSION_ADJUSTMENT`: Adjustment when there are differences in the platform commission paid by the seller.
- `PLATFORM_COMMISSION_COMPENSATION`: Compensation paid to the seller when there are differences in the platform commission paid by the seller.
- `PLATFORM_PENALTY`: Penalty imposed for a violation of TikTok Shop policies (the corresponding amount has been deducted from the seller's account). For details, please refer to the email notification sent to the seller.
- `PROMOTION_ADJUSTMENT`: Adjustment when a seller takes part in a platform promotion and there are differences between the promotion price and the actual amount paid by the seller.
- `REBATE`: A discount on referral fees offered by TikTok Shop to eligible sellers.
- `PLATFORM_COMPENSATION`: Compensation paid to the seller after the seller successfully appealed for a customer dispute.
- `PLATFORM_REIMBURSEMENT`: Reimbursement paid by TikTok Shop for an order refunded under TikTok's refund without return policy (the seller is not responsible).
- `COFUNDED_CREATOR_REWARDS`: Fees charged for joining the co-funded creator rewards program to reward creator activities.
- `STAMP_DUTY`: To comply with Thailand's tax regulations, TikTok Shop withholds and remits the stamp duty levied on the withholding tax agent appointment letter. This document falls under Instrument No. 21 (Agency) and is subject to a THB 30 stamp duty.

**Logistics-related adjustments**
- `FBT_WAREHOUSE_SERVICE_FEE`: Amount charged by TikTok Fulfillment Portal (Pipak) for warehousing-related bills incurred by the seller under the Fulfilled by TikTok (FBT) service.
- `LOGISTICS_REIMBURSEMENT`: Reimbursement paid by TikTok Shop for an order refunded due to logistics-related issues (e.g. lost or damaged order).
- `SHIPPING_FEE_ADJUSTMENT`: Adjustment when there are differences or mistakes with the shipping fee paid by the seller.
- `SHIPPING_FEE_COMPENSATION`: Compensation given to sellers due to differences between the actual shipping fee and the pre-paid shipping fee.
- `SHIPPING_FEE_REBATE`: Shipping fee rebate provided to the seller as part of their participation in a platform campaign.
- `SAMPLE_SHIPPING_FEE`: Fees charged for sending samples using the TikTok logistics provider.
- `SELLER_MISSION_REWARD`: Platform provided cash reward for seller mission completion.
- `Violation fee （settlement fee）`: The deduction to cover the cost of buyer's losses for the unpleasant experience of the buyer due to an issue that is the seller's responsibility.
- `Violation fee （credit card）`: The amount owed to TikTok Shop from previous transactions, charged to your primary credit card.
- `Bill payment （negative balance）`: The amount you owe TikTok Shop, charged to your primary credit card.
-  `Sales proceed（negative balance） `:Sales proceed that is ready to pay for negeative balance.
-  `Bill deduction for negative balance `:Deduction for the amount you owe TikTok Shop after all platform fees are deducted from your net earnings.

**Miscellaneous adjustments**
`OTHER_ADJUSTMENT`: Adjustment for other reasons.

order_id.description:
The order ID.
Each transaction can only be associated with an order ID or an adjustment ID.

order_create_time.description: The creation time of the order. Unix timestamp.

adjustment_id.description:
The adjustment ID if the transaction is an adjustment.
Each transaction can only be associated with an order ID or an adjustment ID.

adjustment_order_id.description: The order ID associated with the adjustment, if any.

adjustment_amount.description:
The adjustment amount based on TikTok Shop policy. 
Refer to `transactions.type` for the list of adjustment-related policies.

settlement_amount.description:
The settlement amount for the order.

Formula: revenue_amount - shipping_cost_amount - fee_tax_amount - adjustment_amount

revenue_amount.description: The revenue amount at the time of order settlement. This is equivalent to the sum of all amounts in `revenue_breakdown`.

subtotal_before_discount_amount.description: The total price of all order items before any seller discounts and platform discounts are deducted. This is equivalent to the shop's gross sales.

refund_subtotal_before_discount_amount.description: The total price of all refunded items before any seller discounts. This is equivalent to the shop's gross sales refund.

seller_discount_amount.description:
The total amount of discounts funded by the seller, including:
- Seller promotions (Product Discount, Flash Deal, Buy More Save More, Voucher and Bundle Deal)
- Seller's portion of a co-funded voucher discount in co-funding campaigns
- Seller discounts during a campaign

seller_discount_refund_amount.description: Discounts returned to the sellers due to returns or refunds.

cod_service_fee_amount.description:
The cash on delivery service fees charged to buyers.
Applicable only for Saudi Arabia.

refund_cod_service_fee_amount.description:
The refund for cash on delivery service fees.
Applicable only for Saudi Arabia.

distant_item_fee_amount.description: The distance fee for items paid by the customer. With your current settings for Horizon+ Program, this fee is included in product price for orders with shipping out of Java island.

revenue_breakdown.description: The list of amounts that directly contribute to `revenue_amount`.

shipping_cost_amount.description: The shipping costs at the time of order settlement. This is equivalent to the sum of all contributory amounts in `shipping_cost_breakdown`.

actual_shipping_fee_amount.description: The actual shipping fee calculated based on the weight/dimensions measured by the carrier. For details, check `shipping_cost_breakdown.supplementary_component`.

shipping_fee_discount_amount.description: The shipping fee subsidies and incentives provided by the platform. This includes all subsidies regardless of fulfillment channels or policies. For details, check `shipping_cost_breakdown.supplementary_component`.

customer_paid_shipping_fee_amount.description: The actual shipping fee borne by the customer, calculated based on the product weight uploaded by the seller. Negative numbers refer to the refunded amount of customer-paid shipping fees

return_shipping_fee_amount.description: The shipping fee paid by the seller for the delivery of returns.

replacement_shipping_fee_amount.description:
The shipping fee paid by the seller for the delivery of goods replacement.

Applicable only for Indonesia.

exchange_shipping_fee_amount.description:
The shipping fee paid by the seller for the delivery of goods exchange.

Applicable only for Indonesia.

signature_confirmation_fee_amount.description: The fee incurred for packages requiring signature confirmation services.

shipping_insurance_fee_amount.description: The shipping insurance fee incurred by the seller for purchasing additional TikTok shipping insurance services.

fbt_fulfillment_fee_reimbursement_amount.description:
A reimbursement from TikTok Shop for Fulfilled by TikTok (FBT) orders that don't qualify for free shipping.
Applicable only for the US.

return_shipping_label_fee_amount.description: The fee borne by the customer to cover the cost of return labels. This fee is collected on the seller's behalf and settled according to the agreed payment terms.

seller_self_shipping_service_fee_amount.description: A service fee charged for orders shipped through your own logistics provider. Applies to packages that don't meet the exemption criteria.

return_shipping_fee_paid_buyer_amount.description: Reimbursement for the shipping fees paid by customers to return packages

failed_delivery_subsidy_amount.description: For shipping fee from failed deliveries, you pay up to a standard rate, and TikTok Shop covers the remaining amount.

shipping_fee_guarantee_reimbursement.description: Reimbursement from the Shipping Fee Guarantee Program for failed deliveries or returns

fbt_free_shipping_fee_amount.description: This is the fee that you cover when offering customers free shipping through FBT.

free_return_subsidy_amount.description: Reimbursement for the platform-funded portion of return shipping fees, as part of the free returns offered to customers.

distant_shipping_fee_amount.description: The distance fee for shipping paid by the customer. With your current settings for Horizon+ Program, this fee is included in product price for orders with shipping out of Java island.

shipping_app_service_fee_amount.description: Shipping App Service Fee for using shipping fee to generate shipping labels

logistics_service_fee.description: A fee charged to sellers throughout the order lifecycle for logistics-related services, including processing, coordination, handling of delivery-related matters, and basic shipping incentives. It is an amount per order, which is based on the parcel's weight tier and shipping route. It allows the platform to continuously enhance a high-quality, sustainable logistics network that serves both sellers and customers better over the long term, amidst changing global conditions.

fbt_overall_merchant_subsidy.description: Subsidy applied to your orders and offered to all FBT (Fulfilled by TikTok) merchants for the statement period. The amount is calculated based on your qualifying FBT order volume during this period.

fbt_key_merchant_subsidy.description: Subsidy applied to your orders based on eligibility for the key merchant program. The amount is calculated based on your qualifying FBT (Fulfilled by TikTok) order volume during the statement period.

tiktok_shop_shipping_incentive_amount.description: The shipping fee incentive provided by TikTok Shop.

platform_shipping_fee_discount_amount.description: The shipping fee discount provided in accordance with a campaign policy. This is part of `shipping_fee_discount_amount`.

promo_shipping_incentive_amount.description: The additional shipping incentive that the seller will receive if the seller signed up for the Co-Funded Free Shipping Program. A negative amount indicates a reversal of incentives due to order refunds attributed to the seller's responsibility. This is part of `shipping_fee_discount_amount`.

shipping_fee_subsidy_amount.description:
The shipping fee subsidy funded by the platform for seller shipping. This is part of `shipping_fee_discount_amount`.
- Positive amount represents a subsidy received by the seller.
- Negative amount represents a subsidy that the seller must return to TikTok Shop.

seller_shipping_fee_discount_amount.description: The shipping fee discount provided by sellers.

customer_shipping_fee_offset_amount.description:
The fee to offset TikTok Shop Shipping Incentive or customer-paid shipping fee, resulting in a net charge of $0 to the seller.

Applicable only for the US.

fbm_shipping_cost_amount.description: The shipping fee incurred by the seller for using TikTok Shipping. This is part of `actual_shipping_fee_amount`.

fbt_shipping_cost_amount.description:
The shipping fee incurred by the seller for orders fulfilled by TikTok (FBT). This is part of `actual_shipping_fee_amount`.

Applicable only for EU and UK.

fbt_fulfillment_fee_amount.description:
The shipping and warehouse fulfillment fee incurred by the seller for orders fulfilled by TikTok (FBT). This is part of `actual_shipping_fee_amount`.

Applicable only for the US.

fbt_fulfillment_fee_reimbursement_amount.description: (**Deprecated**: This field is deprecated and will return an empty string. Please refer to `shipping_cost_breakdown.fbt_fulfillment_fee_reimbursement_amount` instead for the relevant details.)

return_refund_subsidy_amount.description: For shipping fee from returns and refunds, you pay up to a standard rate, and TikTok Shop covers the remaining amount.This is part of `customer_paid_shipping_fee_amount`.

refunded_customer_shipping_fee_amount.description: Shipping fee returned to customers due returns and refunds.Does not include subsidies.This is part of `customer_paid_shipping_fee_amount`.

customer_shipping_fee.description: The shipping fee borne by the customer.This is part of `customer_paid_shipping_fee_amount`.

refund_customer_shipping_fee.description: Refund the shipping fee borne by the customer. Include subsidies.This is part of `customer_paid_shipping_fee_amount`.

supplementary_component.description: Supplementary costs for your reference. These amounts do not directly contribute to `shipping_cost_amount`.

shipping_cost_breakdown.description: The list of amounts that directly contribute to `shipping_cost_amount`.

fee_tax_amount.description: The total fees and taxes charged by TikTok Shop at the time of order settlement. Shipping-related costs are excluded. This is equivalent to the sum of all contributory amounts in `fee_tax_breakdown`.

platform_commission_amount.description: The commission amount charged by the platform.

referral_fee_amount.description:
The referral fee charged for processing successful orders.

Applicable only for the US.

refund_administration_fee_amount.description: The 20% refund administration fee deducted from the total refunded referral fee amount.

transaction_fee_amount.description: The transaction fee charged for processing successful orders.

credit_card_handling_fee_amount.description: The handling fee charged when the buyer pays with a credit card.

affiliate_commission_amount.description: The commission amount charged to the seller for payment to the creator.

affiliate_commission_amount_before_pit.description:
The affiliate ads commission paid to a creator before any personal income tax withholding.

Applicable only for SEA markets.

affiliate_partner_commission_amount.description: The commission amount for purchases through affiliate partner links.

affiliate_ads_commission_amount.description: The commission for eligible orders from ads.

sfp_service_fee_amount.description: The service fee charged for participation in the [Seller Free Shipping Programme].

live_specials_fee_amount.description: The service fee charged for participation in the [LIVE Specials Programme].

bonus_cashback_service_fee_amount.description: The service fee charged for participation in the bonus cashback program.

mall_service_fee_amount.description: The service fee charged for using TikTok Shop Mall.

voucher_xtra_service_fee_amount.description: The service fee charged for participation in the Voucher Xtra program.

flash_sales_service_fee_amount.description: The service fee charged for participation in flash sales.

cofunded_promotion_service_fee_amount.description: The service fee charged for co-funded promotions.

pre_order_service_fee_amount.description: The service fee charged for participation in the pre-order program.

tsp_commission_amount.description: The commission amount charged by TikTok Shop Partners (TSP).

dt_handling_fee_amount.description: The handling fee charged for orders that are fulfilled by Dilayani Tokopedia.

epr_pob_service_fee_amount.description: The eco-contributions TikTok Shop pays on your behalf to the qualified producer responsibility organization (PRO).

seller_paylater_handling_fee_amount.description: The handling fee charged to the seller for participation in the PayLater program.

fee_per_item_sold_amount.description:
The fee charged to sellers by the platform for each item sold. This is equivalent to the sum of all per-item fees for all SKUs in the order.
Applicable only for the Brazil market.

cofunded_creator_bonus_amount.description: The portion of the creator bonus that you co-fund as part of the commission boost campaign.

dynamic_commission_amount.description:
The dynamic commission fee is the amount that the platform charges to all sellers for every successfully delivered order.
Applicable only for Indonesia.

external_affiliate_marketing_fee_amount.description: The service fee for participating in the External Affiliate Marketing Solution Program, as stated during registration.

vn_fix_infrastructure_fee.description: Infrastructure fees are a fixed service fee that TikTok Shop charges for providing, maintaining, and developing infrastructure for delivery services. It applies to delivered orders on the main order level.

affiliate_commission_deposit.description: The amount reserved for creator commissions after an order is paid. Applies only to commissions tied to order volume and is based on the highest earning rate.

affiliate_commission_release.description: The commission deposit refunded to you after order settlement. Applies only to commissions tied to order volume.

tap_shop_ads_commission.description: The advertising commission cost a merchant pays to TikTok Shop Affiliate Partner (TAP).

shipping_fee_guarantee_service_fee.description: A flat service fee charged for each order under the Shipping Fee Guarantee Program

installation_service_fee.description: The fee TikTok Shop charges you for using platform installation service

campaign_resource_fee.description: Amount of campaign resource fee from program seller joining in

platform_special_service_fee_amount.description: The portion of the Distance Shipping Fee paid by the customer that exceeds the logistics service provider's charge, retained by TikTok Shop to support a secure fulfillment experience

smart_promotion_fee_amount.description: This fee includes funds from TikTok Shop to help provide promotions to customers

gmv_max_ad_fee_amount.description: A percentage deducted from your net sales per order for GMV Max (net sales performance goal) advertising.

platform_semi_managed_commission_fee.description: Calculated as a percentage of (original price − seller discount + customer-paid shipping fee).

platform_semi_managed_commission_fee_tax.description: This amount is collected on behalf of the government.

campaign_period_fee_cfp_amount.description: Fee charged during Co-funded Promotion campaigns.

campaign_period_fee_sp_amount.description: Fee charged during Smart Promotion campaigns.

campaign_period_fee_sp_tax_amount.description: Sales tax applied to the campaign period fee under Smart Promotion.

campaign_period_fee_cfp_tax_amount.description: Sales tax applied to the campaign period fee under Co-funded Promotion.

seller_growth_fee_amount.description: A fee charged on each successful order to provide Bonus Cashback and other growth benefits.

category_led_campaign_fee_amount.description: Fee charged for participating in the Category-led campaign.

category_led_campaign_fee_tax_amount.description: Sales tax charged for the fee.

brand_amplification_program_commission.description: Commission fee charged for participating in the Brand Amplification Program.

brand_amplification_program_fee_tax.description: Sales tax charged for the fee.

brand_campaign_fee.description: Fee charged for participating in the Brand campaign.

brand_campaign_fee_tax.description: Sales tax charged for the fee.

failed_delivery_shipping_fee.description: Shipping fee for order that failed to be delivered to the customer.  In some cases, the fee may be shared between seller and platform.

buyer_fault_return_shipping_fee.description: Shipping fee for buyer-fault returns. In some cases, the fee may be shared between seller and platform.

insurance_fee.description: Premium charged per order for insurance coverage

gmv_max_coupon_fee.description: The cost of GMV Max coupons.

cps_shop_ads_commission_tax_amount.description: Sales tax applied to GMV Max ad fee

vat_amount.description:
The VAT paid by the platform on the seller's behalf. 

Applicable only for cross-border shop orders.

import_vat_amount.description:
The import VAT, a tax paid on goods bought in one country and imported into another. 
Applicable only for cross-border shop orders. In Japan, it refers to the Japan Consumption Tax (JCT).

customs_duty_amount.description:
The customs duties, a type of tax on cross-border goods collected by governments. 

Applicable only for cross-border shop orders.

customs_clearance_amount.description:
The fees charged by logistic suppliers for customs clearance services. 

Applicable only for cross-border shop orders.

sst_amount.description: The sales and service tax (SST) collected and remitted to the tax authority by the platform for low-value goods imported into Malaysia, effective January 1, 2024.

gst_amount.description: The goods and services tax (GST) collected and remitted to the tax authority by the platform for low-value goods imported into Singapore, effective January 1, 2023.

iva_amount.description: The Mexican VAT that TikTok Shop is required to withhold on your taxable products and remit to the tax authority.

isr_amount.description: The Mexican federal income tax that TikTok Shop is required to withhold.

anti_dumping_duty_amount.description: The anti-dumping duties collected by governments for import goods.

local_vat_amount.description: The VAT paid by the platform on the seller's behalf. Applicable only for local shop orders.

pit_amount.description: The personal income tax (PIT) paid by the platform on the seller's behalf.

sales_tax_referral_fee_amount.description: Some U.S. states consider referral fees taxable. To comply with state tax laws, TikTok Inc. collects and remits applicable sales tax when a taxable fee is charged.

smart_promotion_fee_tax_amount.description: Sales tax for the Smart Promotion fee

fee_tax_breakdown.description: The list of amounts that directly contribute to `fee_tax_amount`.

customer_payment_amount.description: The total amount paid by the customer.

customer_refund_amount.description: The exact amount refunded to the customer.

platform_discount_amount.description: The discounts funded by the platform, such as coupons and campaign discounts.

platform_discount_refund_amount.description: The platform discounts to be reversed (and deducted from the final settlement) if the order was refunded as a result of the seller's responsibility.

seller_cofunded_discount_amount.description: The seller's portion of a co-funded voucher discount in co-funding campaigns.

seller_cofunded_discount_refund_amount.description: The seller's portion of a co-funded voucher discount in co-funding campaigns that was refunded to the seller.

platform_cofunded_discount_amount.description: The platform's portion of a co-funded voucher discount in co-funding campaigns.

platform_cofunded_discount_refund_amount.description: The platform's portion of a co-funded voucher discount in co-funding campaigns that was refunded to the platform.

retail_delivery_fee_amount.description:
The final retail delivery fee for deliveries in Colorado, US. For more information, see [Colorado Retail Delivery Fee FAQ](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=2459780628350762&default_language=en&identity=1).


Formula: retail_delivery_fee_payment + retail_delivery_fee_refund

retail_delivery_fee_payment_amount.description: The retail delivery fee for deliveries in Colorado, US. For more information, see [Colorado Retail Delivery Fee FAQ](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?knowledge_id=2459780628350762&default_language=en&identity=1).

retail_delivery_fee_refund_amount.description: The retail delivery fee subsidy by the platform for losses due to returns, refunds, or other issues in Colorado, US.

sales_tax_amount.description:
The final sales tax to be paid by the customer for the product and delivery. 

Formula: sales_tax_payment_amount - sales_tax_refund_amount

sales_tax_payment_amount.description: The expected sales tax to be paid by the customer for the product and delivery.

sales_tax_refund_amount.description: The sales tax amount returned to the customer in the event of a refund.

supplementary_component.description: Supplementary costs for your reference. These amounts do not directly contribute to the settlement amount.

reserve_id.description: The ID of a reserve transaction.

reserve_amount.description:
The amount withheld from settlement based on TikTok Shop Reserve Policy. Refer to TikTok Shop Academy for more information.
- A positive amount indicates funds that have been released.
- A negative amount indicates funds being withheld from the settlement.

associated_order_id.description: The order ID associated with the reserve transaction.

reserve_status.description:
The status of the reserve funds.
Possible values:
- COLLECTED: A portion of the order's settlement amount has been withheld as reserve funds.
- RELEASED: The previously reserved funds have been released and paid out to the seller.

estimated_release_time.description:
The estimated date when the reserve funds will be released and paid out to the seller. Unix timestamp. 
Returns an empty value if the reserve funds have already been released.

transactions.description: The list of transaction records in the statement. Each transaction corresponds to an order, an adjustment, or a reserve-related transaction.

The transaction type.

**Standard transactions**
- `ORDER`: A transaction related to an order settlement.
- `RESERVE`: A transaction involving collection or release of reserve funds.
- If the transaction is an adjustment, it returns one of the following values:

**Platform-related adjustments**
- `CHARGE_BACK`: Charges returned to a payment card after a customer has successfully disputed an item on their account statement or transactions report.
- `CUSTOMER_SERVICE_COMPENSATION`: Extra compensation or compensation paid to a customer after the after-sales period by customer service.
- `DEDUCTIONS_INCURRED_BY_SELLER`: Deduction arising from customer dissatisfaction as a result of the seller's responsibility. This includes issues such as fraud, empty packages, items that do not match the product display page, or items of lower value than advertised.
- `GMV_PAYMENT_FOR_ADS`: Amount used to pay for your advertisement if you are enabled "auto pay ads with shop GMV", or to pay for Tiktok Promote ads orders.
- `PLATFORM_COMMISSION_ADJUSTMENT`: Adjustment when there are differences in the platform commission paid by the seller.
- `PLATFORM_COMMISSION_COMPENSATION`: Compensation paid to the seller when there are differences in the platform commission paid by the seller.
- `PLATFORM_PENALTY`: Penalty imposed for a violation of TikTok Shop policies (the corresponding amount has been deducted from the seller's account). For details, please refer to the email notification sent to the seller.
- `PROMOTION_ADJUSTMENT`: Adjustment when a seller takes part in a platform promotion and there are differences between the promotion price and the actual amount paid by the seller.
- `REBATE`: A discount on referral fees offered by TikTok Shop to eligible sellers.
- `PLATFORM_COMPENSATION`: Compensation paid to the seller after the seller successfully appealed for a customer dispute.
- `PLATFORM_REIMBURSEMENT`: Reimbursement paid by TikTok Shop for an order refunded under TikTok's refund without return policy (the seller is not responsible).
- `COFUNDED_CREATOR_REWARDS`: Fees charged for joining the co-funded creator rewards program to reward creator activities.
- `STAMP_DUTY`: To comply with Thailand's tax regulations, TikTok Shop withholds and remits the stamp duty levied on the withholding tax agent appointment letter. This document falls under Instrument No. 21 (Agency) and is subject to a THB 30 stamp duty.

**Logistics-related adjustments**
- `FBT_WAREHOUSE_SERVICE_FEE`: Amount charged by TikTok Fulfillment Portal (Pipak) for warehousing-related bills incurred by the seller under the Fulfilled by TikTok (FBT) service.
- `LOGISTICS_REIMBURSEMENT`: Reimbursement paid by TikTok Shop for an order refunded due to logistics-related issues (e.g. lost or damaged order).
- `SHIPPING_FEE_ADJUSTMENT`: Adjustment when there are differences or mistakes with the shipping fee paid by the seller.
- `SHIPPING_FEE_COMPENSATION`: Compensation given to sellers due to differences between the actual shipping fee and the pre-paid shipping fee.
- `SHIPPING_FEE_REBATE`: Shipping fee rebate provided to the seller as part of their participation in a platform campaign.
- `SAMPLE_SHIPPING_FEE`: Fees charged for sending samples using the TikTok logistics provider.
- `SELLER_MISSION_REWARD`: Platform provided cash reward for seller mission completion.
- `Violation fee （settlement fee）`: The deduction to cover the cost of buyer's losses for the unpleasant experience of the buyer due to an issue that is the seller's responsibility.
- `Violation fee （credit card）`: The amount owed to TikTok Shop from previous transactions, charged to your primary credit card.
- `Bill payment （negative balance）`: The amount you owe TikTok Shop, charged to your primary credit card.
-  `Sales proceed（negative balance） `:Sales proceed that is ready to pay for negeative balance.
-  `Bill deduction for negative balance `:Deduction for the amount you owe TikTok Shop after all platform fees are deducted from your net earnings.

**Miscellaneous adjustments**
`OTHER_ADJUSTMENT`: Adjustment for other reasons.
